attributes.action: Give more funding to the Armed Forces
attributes.background: A petition for more Armed Forces funding could help improve equipment, vehicles, pay and housing. It would support recruitment and ensure the UK is prepared for future threats.

rejection.details: Your petition isn't clear as to how much more funding you want the Armed Forces to receive or what you might want that funding used for - the Govt has increased MoD/defence funding so you would need to be clearer about to what extent that is not sufficient and what you would want so see additional money spent on.
